source.shows: a truncated scale where it is fine: the zero of a rating is arbitrary, so the procedure gives dots on a scale that starts near the data (G1.57, G2.8, G2.10); horizontal by choice, with the reason, and the scale’s title below, “Satisfaction rating (on 10)”; the book draws 7–10 by 1 with the levels “Neutral” and “Very satisfied” named above the scale (G2.10), which the generator does not draw yet
